author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the trailer for Dark Adelita, an upcoming sidescrolling shooter game. As Angela, a veteran of the revolutionary struggle, players embark on a dark journey through Mexican states. Dark Adelita will be available on PC via Steam on May 5, 2026.

It’s 1918, and the Mexican Revolution is coming to an end after years of bitter fighting. As change sweeps across the suffering land, however, an ancient evil awakens. Feeding on the fears and suffering of a devastated people, it brings creatures straight from Mexican legends to life. Blight and darkness spread across the land - and only one, a brave adelita called Angela, can face the darkness. With a rifle in hand, she sets out on a path that will test her physical strength and mental endurance…
title: Dark Adelita - Official Release Date Trailer

description:

Fend off against hordes of foxes, unlock new abilities, and traverse a simulation that's deteriorating by the second. MetaHustle One is coming soon to PC (Steam).

Wishlist the game here on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4556780/MetaHustle_One/

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Drop Duchy: Complete Edition announcement trailer for this block-dropping meets strategic kingdom-building hybrid game. Drop Duchy: Complete Edition will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Nintendo Switch on April 21, 2026. Drop Duchy: Complete Edition launches day one with the previously released The North and The Tribe DLCs included.

Drop Duchy challenges leaders to thoughtfully build their lands by dropping blocks containing forests, plains, rivers and structures for their people (think Tetris meets Carcassonne). Clever placements make the difference between reaping bonus rewards and advantages for your people or falling to the mercenary camps eager to end your rule.
title: Drop Duchy: Complete Edition - Official Consoles Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Call of the Elder Gods gets a new trailer and a release date announcement. Watch the latest Call of the Elder Gods trailer for this upcoming Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure game sequel to Call of the Sea. Call of the Elder Gods will be available on PC (via Steam), Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S on May 12, 2026. It will also be available day one with Xbox Game Pass.

In Call of the Elder Gods, step into the roles of Professor Harry Everhart and newcomer Evangeline Drayton, solving intricate puzzles driven by logic, observation, and environmental interaction. Together, they journey from New England to the Australian desert, the frozen Arctic and the ancient city of Pnakotus, searching for missing loved ones while confronting personal grief.
title: Call of the Elder Gods - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Game of Thrones: Dragonfire announcement trailer for this upcoming free-to-play mobile strategy game based on the Emmy Award-winning original drama series, House of the Dragon. Game of Thrones: Dragonfire will be available on the App Store and Google Play, and pre-registration is available now.

Drawing inspiration from events portrayed in House of the Dragon, players will experience a new narrative as a Valyrian descendant tasked with hatching, raising and flying dragons. Fans will encounter both familiar faces and original characters, form alliances and factions with other players, as well as engage in tactical battles to become a true dragonrider and dominant force in Westeros.

#GameOfThronesDragonfire #Gaming #IGN
title: Game of Thrones: Dragonfire - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at gameplay from Tsarevna: Age of Tales in this latest trailer for the upcoming ballet-inspired action slasher game from WATT Studio. The new Tsarevna: Age of Tales trailer showcases ballet-driven combat, fast-paced melee, and its dark Slavic fantasy setting. We also get to see magical weapon transformations, combos, swift dodges, and a combat system built around movement and rhythm. Tsarevna: Age of Tales will be available on PC.

Tsarevna: Age of Tales is an upcoming game where grace turns into violence and revenge consumes the soul. Master breathtaking, fluid combat, slaughter the servants of Darkness, and step into the war against the Slavic gods.
title: Tsarevna: Age of Tales - Official Gameplay Trailer
